expected_root_cause: parseFlags stores firstArg, a trimmed value used for classification, in positional arguments. This changes the user-visible argument instead of retaining rargs[0], which contains the original whitespace.
fix_summary: Continue using the trimmed value to classify flags, but append the original rargs[0] to positional arguments so command actions receive exact input.
curation_notes: PR #2423 adds a regression test with leading spaces and tab characters and changes only the positional argument value selected by command_parse.go.
